file-open.why: File > Open shows the native picker (or JFileChooser), which cannot be driven; with the path given as macro options OpenDialog keeps no title (OpenDialog.java:36-60), so Recorder.recordPath(null, path) records nothing. After a pick, getFileName (:209-216) calls Recorder.recordPath("Open", dir+name) -> options open=<path>; Recorder.saveCommand :585-586 then recordOpen(strip(options)) :484-498 writes open("<path>"); with the path through fixPath (forward slashes)
